title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Funding Fee Refund Booking
content:
A VA Home Loan Guaranty funding fee refund is figured on one funding fee charge of a veteran's loan and booked against that charge. The amount booked is the refund paid to the veteran on the charge, rounded to the cent.

## What booking a refund does

Booking a refund adds one refund entry to the loan's money transactions, tied to the funding fee charge it settles and dated today, carrying the amount refunded and the ground for the refund. The loan's record of funding fee paid is reduced by that amount. Afterwards the refund entry appears among the loan's money transactions next to the funding fee charge it settles.

## Invocation

The refund is booked with the agent-side tool `refund_funding_fee_5c21eab8`. The representative unlocks it (`unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`) and then calls it (`call_agent_discoverable_tool`). Each call books one refund entry against one funding fee charge.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loan_id` | The reference number of the veteran's VA home loan record on which the fee was charged, as returned by the loan lookup for this veteran | Identifier |
| `source_txn_id` | The reference number of the funding fee charge entry being refunded, as returned by the loan money-transaction lookup for that loan | Identifier |
| `amount` | The amount refunded to the veteran | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |
| `refund_basis` | The ground for the refund | Exactly one value from the list below |

Values of `refund_basis`:

- `retroactive_compensation_award`: the veteran was later awarded disability compensation effective on or before the loan's closing date.
- `purple_heart_after_closing`: the veteran received the Purple Heart after the closing date while serving on active duty.
- `fee_collected_in_error`: the fee, or part of it, should not have been collected for any other reason.
- `not_applicable`: the entry is not a funding fee refund at all, so it never applies to a refund booked with this tool.

### Return

On success the tool returns a receipt with `loan_txn_id` (the reference number of the new refund entry), `loan_id` (the loan refunded), `source_txn_id` (the fee charge settled), `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places, the amount refunded), `transaction_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `status`, which is always `refund_booked` when the refund entry was written. The tool defines no other outcome.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

A call with a loan reference, the reference of one funding fee charge entry on that loan, `amount` 240.00 and `refund_basis` `fee_collected_in_error` returns a receipt whose `status` is `refund_booked`, whose `amount` is 240.00 and whose `transaction_date` is today. The loan's money transactions then show a refund entry tied to that charge.
